items.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: CLK-001 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; CLK-001 [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
CLK-001: an operation that reads the current time — to write a
  timestamp or to compare the current time with a stored one, a session or
  credential expiry check included — takes one wall reading from the clock
  source, the only reader of the host clocks; that instant is every
  current time the operation uses, and every portal-owned event timestamp
  it writes, other than an audit record's `occurred_at` taken by the audit
  writer, is that instant; an expiry it derives from a TTL is that instant
  plus its TTL; source-supplied times and dates, a service credential's
  supplied `expires_at` among them, keep their supplied values.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-006 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
quotes: assert disabled.status == PrincipalStatus.DISABLED and disabled.disabled_by == ADMIN_ID
verdicts.why: The check detects that a credential becomes unusable after its service principal is disabled. It does not test suspended or disabled staff accounts or the invalidation of their sessions and credentials.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-029 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-029 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-029: a producer import is authorized for the target project per scope_mode and grants before content validation
quotes: assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, PROJECT_ID) is True
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, OTHER_PROJECT_ID) is False
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, ARCHIVED_PROJECT_ID) is False
verdicts.why: The check asserts target-project scope decisions for granted-projects and all-projects principals. It does not execute a producer import or establish that authorization occurs before content validation.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: read value unchanged [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal]; read value unchanged [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: A value read from a repository is unchanged after any use case that read it.
verdicts.why: The check does not assert that repository values remain unchanged after every reading use case; preserving selected fields in returned updated records and observing whether a repository update method ran do not detect in-place mutation of every value read.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: CLK-001 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; CLK-001 [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
CLK-001: an operation that reads the current time — to write a
  timestamp or to compare the current time with a stored one, a session or
  credential expiry check included — takes one wall reading from the clock
  source, the only reader of the host clocks; that instant is every
  current time the operation uses, and every portal-owned event timestamp
  it writes, other than an audit record's `occurred_at` taken by the audit
  writer, is that instant; an expiry it derives from a TTL is that instant
  plus its TTL; source-supplied times and dates, a service credential's
  supplied `expires_at` among them, keep their supplied values.
quotes: assert principal.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and principal.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert issue.credential.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and issue.credential.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert revoked.revoked_at == CLOCK_NOW and revoked.revoked_at.tzinfo is None
assert grant.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and grant.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert disabled.disabled_at == CLOCK_NOW and disabled.disabled_at.tzinfo is None
verdicts.why: Selected operations are required to capture the controlled clock once, and several written timestamps are checked against that instant. The check does not cover every time-reading operation or the invariant's TTL-derived expiry, supplied-time preservation, and portal-event timestamp requirements.

statements: INV-009: at most one active grant per (viewer_id, project_id) and per (service_principal_id, project_id)
quotes: "second active grant for the same project",
verdicts.why: The check detects a second active service-principal grant for the same project. It does not test uniqueness of viewer grants per viewer and project.
